name: Surface-refinement selector unit verification
purpose: Verify the historical no-input callback and the input-driven M1 radial, SZA, terminator, and polar resolution kernels before linked mesh construction.
configuration: Historical DebugRunMultiplier=4 branch plus explicit FULL and QUICK M1 targets. FULL uses 10 km near-surface through 200 km, 40 km at 10,000 km, 17,371 km at the outer boundary, and 5 km terminator/polar minima; QUICK uses three times every FULL target while retaining the same physical extents and region boundaries.
inputs: SZA control points and interpolation fixtures
near, science-region, and outer radial transition endpoints
independent_reference: Direct piecewise-linear, minimum-selector, and dimensionless logarithmic-transition evaluations at exact control points.
frame_time_convention: Moon-centred LSO SZA and pre-transformed absolute MOON_ME_DE421 latitude; static fixtures.
procedure: Invoke the compiled historical callbacks and production configuration kernels at FULL knots, an interpolation point, terminator/polar overlaps, and radial endpoints; independently construct the factor-three QUICK receipt and verify its terminator, polar, near-surface, science-endpoint, and outer-boundary targets.
metrics: FULL terminator and polar selector errors
acceptance_criteria: Every value is within 1e-14 relative of its independently evaluated reference.
expected_pass_result: The legacy regression remains unchanged and all input-driven FULL and QUICK kernel branches reproduce their explicit analytical contracts.
status_semantics: PASS verifies production-kernel arithmetic, not linked realized-cell placement (I12) or science-observable convergence (I11).
